title: Model Merging Does Not Require Uniform LoRA Ranks
abstract: arXiv:2611.06486v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model merging combines separately fine-tuned experts into a single model without retraining. Standard practice trains every expert at the same LoRA rank, which couples the rank choice across experts even though each domain has its own best rank. We show this coupling is a property of the merge method, not of merging. We train 36 experts on three domains (mathematics, instruction following, multilingual) at four ranks and three model scales, then merge with six methods at uniform ranks and at each domain's own best rank. Giving experts different ranks costs averaging and utility-based selection nothing, and gains them up to 1.8 pp of multi-domain accuracy, while the conflict-resolution methods are inconsistent and can lose up to 4 pp. The split has a simple cause. translated_title: 模型合并不需要统一的LoRA秩
translated_abstract: 模型合并将各自独立微调的专家模型组合为单一模型，而无需重新训练。标准做法是以相同的LoRA秩训练每个专家，这使得秩的选择在各专家之间相互耦合，尽管每个领域其实都有各自的最佳秩。我们证明这种耦合是合并方法的特性，而非合并本身的固有属性。我们在三个领域（数学、指令遵循、多语言）、四种秩和三种模型规模下训练了36个专家模型，然后用六种方法分别在统一秩和各领域自身最佳秩下进行合并。为专家分配不同秩对平均法和基于效用的选择方法没有任何代价，反而可带来最高1.8个百分点的多领域准确率提升，而冲突解决类方法表现不一致，最多可能损失4个百分点。这种差异有一个简单的原因：合并仅保留汇集谱成分中的固定比例，而按大小选择这些成分的方法会丢弃许多本可以降低损失的成分。它们还倾向于丢弃…
tldr: 该论文证明模型合并不要求各专家使用统一的LoRA秩，为不同领域专家分配各自的最佳秩可让平均法和基于效用的选择方法零成本地提升最多1.8个百分点的多领域准确率，而冲突解决类方法则表现不一致甚至可能损失4个百分点。
en_tdlr: Model merging does not require uniform LoRA ranks—assigning each expert its own best rank improves averaging and utility-based merging by up to 1.8 pp of multi-domain accuracy at no cost, while conflict-resolution methods behave inconsistently and can lose up to 4 pp.
